SELECT ci.id, ci.check_in_code AS checkInCode, ci.title, ci.elder_id AS elderId, ci.counselor, ci.check_in_time AS checkInTime, ci.reason, ci.remark, ci.applicat, ci.dept_no AS deptNo, ci.applicat_id AS applicatId, ci.create_time AS createTime, ci.flow_status AS flowStatus, ci.status, ci.other_apply_info AS otherApplyInfo, ci.review_info AS reviewInfo, ci.update_time AS updateTime, e.name AS elderName, e.id_card_no AS elderIdCardNo, e.bed_number AS bedNumber, cfg.check_in_start_time AS checkInStartTime, cfg.check_in_end_time AS checkInEndTime, nl.name AS nursingLevelName FROM check_in ci LEFT JOIN elder e ON ci.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN check_in_config cfg ON ci.elder_id = cfg.elder_id LEFT JOIN nursing_level nl ON cfg.nursing_level_id = nl.id
ORDER BY ci.create_time DESC

SELECT ci.id, ci.check_in_code AS checkInCode, ci.title, ci.elder_id AS elderId, ci.counselor, ci.check_in_time AS checkInTime, ci.reason, ci.remark, ci.applicat, ci.applicat_id AS applicatId, ci.flow_status AS flowStatus, ci.status, ci.other_apply_info AS otherApplyInfo, ci.review_info AS reviewInfo, ci.create_time AS createTime, ci.update_time AS updateTime, e.name AS elderName, e.id_card_no AS elderIdCardNo, e.phone AS elderPhone, e.sex AS elderSex, e.age AS elderAge, e.image AS elderImage, e.bed_number AS bedNumber, e.bed_id AS bedId, cfg.bed_no AS configBedNo, cfg.check_in_start_time AS checkInStartTime, cfg.check_in_end_time AS checkInEndTime, cfg.cost_start_time AS costStartTime, cfg.cost_end_time AS costEndTime, cfg.deposit_amount AS depositAmount, cfg.nursing_cost AS nursingCost, cfg.bed_cost AS bedCost, cfg.other_cost AS otherCost, cfg.medical_insurance_payment AS medicalInsurancePayment, cfg.government_subsidy AS governmentSubsidy, cfg.nursing_level_id AS nursingLevelId, nl.name AS nursingLevelName, ct.name AS contractName, ct.sign_date AS signDate, ct.member_name AS memberName, ct.member_phone AS memberPhone, ct.pdf_url AS pdfUrl, ct.contract_no AS contractNo FROM check_in ci LEFT JOIN elder e ON ci.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN check_in_config cfg ON ci.elder_id = cfg.elder_id LEFT JOIN nursing_level nl ON cfg.nursing_level_id = nl.id LEFT JOIN contract ct ON ci.elder_id = ct.elder_id WHERE ci.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO check_in ( check_in_code, title, elder_id, counselor, check_in_time, reason, remark, applicat, dept_no, applicat_id, flow_status, status, other_apply_info, review_info, create_time ) VALUES ( #{checkInCode}, #{title}, #{elderId}, #{counselor}, #{checkInTime}, #{reason}, #{remark}, #{applicat}, #{deptNo}, #{applicatId}, #{flowStatus}, #{status}, #{otherApplyInfo}, #{reviewInfo}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO check_in_config ( elder_id, bed_no, nursing_level_id, check_in_start_time, check_in_end_time, cost_start_time, cost_end_time, deposit_amount, nursing_cost, bed_cost, other_cost, medical_insurance_payment, government_subsidy, create_time ) VALUES ( #{elderId}, #{bedNo}, #{nursingLevelId}, #{checkInStartTime}, #{checkInEndTime}, #{costStartTime}, #{costEndTime}, #{depositAmount}, #{nursingCost}, #{bedCost}, #{otherCost}, #{medicalInsurancePayment}, #{governmentSubsidy}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO contract ( elder_id, elder_name, name, contract_no, sign_date, start_time, end_time, member_name, member_phone, pdf_url, level_desc, check_in_no, status, create_by, create_time ) VALUES ( #{elderId}, #{elderName}, #{name}, #{contractNo}, #{signDate}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{memberName}, #{memberPhone}, #{pdfUrl}, #{levelDesc}, #{checkInNo}, #{status}, #{createBy}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT r.id, r.name AS elderName, r.id_card_no AS elderIdCardNo, r.check_out_time AS checkOutTime, r.applicat, r.create_time AS createTime FROM retreat r
ORDER BY r.create_time DESC

SELECT r.id, r.retreat_code AS retreatCode, r.title, r.elder_id AS elderId, r.name, r.id_card_no AS idCardNo, r.phone, r.check_in_start_time AS checkInStartTime, r.check_in_end_time AS checkInEndTime, r.nursing_level_name AS nursingLevelName, r.bed_no AS bedNo, r.nursing_name AS nursingName, r.check_out_time AS checkOutTime, r.reason, r.applicat, r.flow_status AS flowStatus, r.status, r.create_time AS createTime, cfg.cost_start_time AS costStartTime, cfg.cost_end_time AS costEndTime, e.bed_number AS bedNumber, ct.release_date AS releaseDate, ct.release_pdf_url AS releasePdfUrl, rb.bill_json AS billJson, rb.refund_voucher_url AS refundVoucherUrl, rb.trading_channel AS tradingChannel, rb.create_time AS refundCreateTime, rb.remark AS refundRemark FROM retreat r LEFT JOIN check_in_config cfg ON r.elder_id = cfg.elder_id LEFT JOIN elder e ON r.elder_id = e.id LEFT JOIN contract ct ON r.elder_id = ct.elder_id LEFT JOIN retreat_bill rb ON r.id = rb.retreat_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO retreat ( retreat_code, title, elder_id, name, id_card_no, phone, check_in_start_time, check_in_end_time, nursing_level_name, bed_no, nursing_name, check_out_time, reason, applicat, applicat_id, dept_no, flow_status, status, create_time ) VALUES ( #{retreatCode}, #{title}, #{elderId}, #{name}, #{idCardNo}, #{phone}, #{checkInStartTime}, #{checkInEndTime}, #{nursingLevelName}, #{bedNo}, #{nursingName}, #{checkOutTime}, #{reason}, #{applicat}, #{applicatId}, #{deptNo}, #{flowStatus}, #{status}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO retreat_bill ( retreat_id, bill_json, refund_voucher_url, trading_channel, elder_id, is_refund, create_time ) VALUES ( #{retreatId}, #{billJson}, #{refundVoucherUrl}, #{tradingChannel}, #{elderId}, #{isRefund}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE contract SET release_date = #{releaseDate}, release_pdf_url = #{releasePdfUrl}, release_submitter = #{releaseSubmitter}, status = 3, update_time = NOW() WHERE elder_id = #{elderId}
